verdict.rationale: Teams supports background automation only through developer-built services. Per the docs, external apps can call Microsoft Graph to automate creating teams and channels and posting messages, incoming webhooks and connectors push updates from external services, and bots can initiate conversations. This means the user must build and host the automation outside Teams, and a community report notes that API integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack. Missing for 10: a native user-facing automation or workflow builder, scheduled or triggered autonomous agents running inside Teams, documentation of background agent execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
